text:
julie_marketing: Hey team - final ask before launch: we need a compact bench artifact we can link in the blog and a tiny local repro for the demo. Two headline numbers: per-token cost delta (quant vs fp16) and p95 coldstart. Keep everything reproducible and include a one-line caveat.

sam_runtime: Sure. We'll run batch=1, concurrency=1 in us-west1 hosted for both variants. We'll produce CSVs, per-1k-token cost, and a demo tarball. Which demo payloads do you want?

julie_marketing: Keep it short: 1) 18-word customer-facing summary 2) 3-bullet reasons platform teams pick Redwood 3) a 2-sentence elevator pitch. <=128 tokens each. Paste below in a sec.

julie_marketing: ```json
[
  {"input":"20-word summary of Redwood Inference for PMs."},
  {"input":"Three reasons platform teams choose a unified inference runtime."},
  {"input":"Two-sentence elevator pitch for the hosted API focusing on latency & cost."}
]
```

todd_bench: Running now. We'll capture: coldstart (fresh node), short steady (30s @ qps=2), and a 3-minute run at qps=4 for stability. Artifacts: latency CSVs, token-cost calc, raw traces, and a tiny repro with Dockerfile + run script. ETA: 3h.

benchbot: benchmark job 1839994330 created for rwd-gen4-small-quant, status: running.

infra-bot: note: first-request numbers in hosted can vary when autoscaler spins up. Recommend adding this exact sentence as a caveat: "Measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; production results may vary by workload, model variant, and deployment mode."

sam_runtime: We'll include infra-bot's sentence verbatim in the README. We'll also give a local reproduction command and a docker image tag so the demo team can run it on stage without cloud autoscaler.

julie_marketing: Also want a tiny JSON snippet we can attach to the lead record so Sales can auto-tag webinar signups that ask about latency/cost. Fields: bench_artifact_id, suggested_sales_tags.

todd_bench: We'll include that in the artifacts. Example we plan to output: {"bench_artifact_id": "1839994330", "suggested_sales_tags": ["webinar-lead","latency-focus","interested-in-dedicated"]} and a small mapping note for CRM.

sam_runtime: Local reproduce example (no autoscaler):
```bash
docker pull redwood/bench:2026-11-01
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:2026-11-01 /app/run.sh \
  --model rwd-gen4-small-quant \
  --endpoint http://localhost:8080/v1/generate \
  --payloads /app/payloads/launch.json \
  --warmup 25 --duration 45 --concurrency 1
```

todd_bench: Uploaded artifacts -> s3://bench-outputs/marketing/1839994330/ (includes CSVs, traces, payloads, README, docker tag). Bench_artifact_id: 1839994330.

julie_marketing: Sweet. Can you paste the one-paragraph plain-English caveat we can drop in the blog under the metric? Keep it short.

sam_runtime: Plain-language caveat: "These numbers were collected with single-request settings to reflect interactive UX. Actual latency and cost may differ for batch workloads, other regions, or Dedicated deployments. See artifact for details and raw traces."

julie_marketing: Perfect. Any odd trace ids or spikes we should know about?

todd_bench: We saw one 4.8s spike in the quant coldstart run (trace id: trace-1839994338) related to node initialization; included condensed trace in artifacts. Otherwise runs were stable.

benchbot: artifacts uploaded and manifest generated for job 1839994330. Presigned link: https://s3.redwood.ai/marketing/1839994330/manifest.json

sam_runtime: Also attaching a tiny JSON ledge for Sales integration: {"bench_artifact_id":"1839994330","crm_field":"custom.bench_artifact_id","tags":["webinar-lead","demo-request"]} — we'll include mapping instructions in README.

julie_marketing: Thanks all. We'll link the S3 manifest in the post, paste the caveat under the slide, and wire bench_artifact_id into the CRM. If Sales needs different tag names we'll ask. :sparkles:
